quarterly_data.quarter: Planet Labs press release: Planet Selected by European Space Agency to Build (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Planet's subsidiary Sinergise Solutions d.o.o. was selected by the European Space Agency (ESA) to build the Slovenia Space Resilience Node under ESA's European Resilience from Space Earth Observation program (Element 2): a 12-month pilot developing a prototype that automates the link from wide-area satellite change detection (open Copernicus data and PlanetScope imagery) to high-resolution tasking, including through Planet's Pelican fleet, for Slovenia's Administration for Civil Protection and Disaster Relief within the Ministry of Defence, in partnership with software developer Lucis d.o.o.; it initially demonstrates tip-and-cue workflows for wildfire management across Slovenia's 20,000 square kilometers.
